task_rationale.repair: 4 test files present — a failing check is a reward
task_rationale.extend: a working test suite grades a follow-up change
task_rationale.build: hidden tests can be held out from the existing suite
task_rationale.qa: oracle = measured repo facts (languages, counts, licence, structure)

verifier.note: run in a sandbox; never on the host

reward.note: verifier correctness dominates; efficiency is a small bonus

safety.note: an agent may edit tests while working; the grader must reset them
